fixTargetedDamageSoak.name: Fix Targeted Damage no Soak for Bennie
fixTargetedDamageSoak.hint: Restore the Soak for Benny button in Targeted Damage when the target has wounds to soak and a Benny is available. Enabled by default.

disableSwadeToolsDialogs.name: Disable SWADE Tools roll dialogs for SWADE HUD
disableSwadeToolsDialogs.hint: Use standard SWADE roll dialogs for HUD rolls and shortcuts while keeping SWADE Tools' automated chat cards. Enabled by default. Turn off to use SWADE Tools' custom dialogs when that module is active and the global override is off. Applies to this client immediately.

disableSwadeToolsDialogsGlobally.name: Disable SWADE Tools roll dialogs globally
disableSwadeToolsDialogsGlobally.hint: Use standard SWADE roll dialogs throughout this client, including actor sheets, macros, other HUDs, and SWADE HUD. Keeps SWADE Tools' automated chat cards and other automation. Takes priority over the HUD-only setting above. Disabled by default; applies to the next roll without reloading.

tokenDistance.name: Token distance
tokenDistance.hint: After hovering a visible, non-adjacent token for 0.3 seconds, show its grid distance from your selected or remembered owned token. The thin line stays below the endpoint tokens and above intervening tokens. Enabled by default; applies immediately.

damageEstimate.name: Damage estimates
damageEstimate.hint: Show minimum and average damage in roll dialogs, including acing and enabled modifiers. Maximum appears only with No Acing checked. Values round down. Enabled by default; applies immediately.

successRates.name: Success rates
successRates.hint: Show critical failure, failure, success, and raise probabilities. Targeted attacks use Parry for melee or TN 4 for ranged, including target defenses from SWADE, Better Effects, and Tools. Target numbers and defense details are only shown to GMs and the target's owner. Enabled by default; applies immediately.

chatRollRange.name: Chat roll range
chatRollRange.hint: Show a red-to-green result bar above the dice in visible roll chat cards, from minimum to average. Values round down; results at or above average fill the bar. Enabled by default; applies immediately.

edges.title: Edges & Hindrances

actions.empty: No action or ability items on this actor.
